problem_statement: A message queue must be able to move all of its messages onto the end of another message queue in one operation. After the operation, the source queue must be empty and the target queue must contain every message that was in the source, appended after any messages the target already held. This must hold for all combinations: both queues empty, only the source populated, only the target populated, both populated, and a no-op when the same queue is used as both target and source (the queue is left unchanged).
